concerns: Envoy webhook finding (spec Design says 'changed only if the current handler errors'): the handler does NOT error on merge_group — it answers 200 — but it PUBLISHES one envelope, which the spec's Requirements row 'answers 200 and publishes nothing' forbids. Proven by running the handler with a documented merge_group delivery on 2026-09-13: status=200, published=1, topic=notifications.github.sjawhar.legion.comment, summary='merge_group checks_requested', payload=''. Cause: contracts/normalize.go githubKind() default returns "comment" (lines 374-375), githubNumber() returns "" for merge_group, so githubTopic() falls through to GithubSubject(owner, repo, "comment") (line 291); GithubEnvelopes() returns that envelope (line 51); Validate() passes because Payload is not a required field; the handler publishes at github.go:198. The daemon's durable consumer filters `notifications.github.<owner>.<repo>.>` (events.ts:838) so it receives the envelope; payloadFrom()/recordPayload() swallow the JSON.parse('') error and reduceGithubEvent returns [] (reducers.ts:853-854), so today's cost is one no-op durable message per merge-group event (two per queued PR: checks_requested and destroyed) plus a meaningless delivery to any session subscribed repo-wide. Therefore the plan includes the minimal handler change (task 3). Architect: please update the spec's Design sentence to match (proposed text under specCorrection).

Production activation of the Envoy fix is an operator step: `Release Envoy Listener` (.github/workflows/release-envoy-listener.yaml) builds and publishes ghcr.io/sjawhar/legion/envoy:<merge-sha> on push to main touching packages/envoy/**, but packages/envoy/deploy/scripts/autodeploy.sh redeploys only the `dispatch` service (line 108/145: `up -d --no-deps dispatch`); the listener container is restarted by the operator (scripts/up-listener.sh or `ENVOY_IMAGE_TAG=<sha> docker compose -f compose/listener.compose.yml pull && up -d`). Until that rollout, merge_group deliveries keep publishing the harmless junk envelope described above. Not a blocker for the administrator's switch; recommended before it. The implementer reports the image tag to the operator session after the merge (deployment instructions: only the operator touches the box).

normalize.go:36-51 GithubEnvelopes: returns nil for a workflow_run with pull_requests and for check_run/check_suite (githubCIEvent), returns nil when githubTopic is "" (line 46-49, today only push to a non-heads/tags ref and workflow_run without path/action), else publishes one envelope. normalize.go:605-606 githubSummary default: `fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", event, action)` → 'merge_group checks_requested' (non-empty, so Validate's payload_summary check passes). normalize.go:749-750 githubPayload default: returns "" (Payload is not validated for presence, generated.go:38-94).

Merge-group check runs: GithubCIObservations (normalize.go:103-113) records only when the check_run/check_suite lists pull_requests (githubCIPullRequests, 460-480); a merge-group commit is not a PR head, so GitHub lists none and nothing is recorded or published. Even if GitHub attached a PR, cistore keys per (owner, repo, number, SHA) and loop.go:48-54 skips any record whose SHA is not the recorded PR head (`cached.SHA != head → continue`), so the PR's `pr.<n>.checks` settlement is never produced from a merge-group SHA. This is the line behind the spec's 'ignored by the checks tracker'.

Merge-queue temporary branches (`gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-<n>-<sha>`) also arrive as `push` events; those publish `notifications.github.sjawhar.legion.push.branch.<sanitized ref>` as any branch push does, and the daemon ignores a push on a branch with no registered PR (reducers `prByBranch` is the only filter, per packages/daemon AGENTS.md).
